card.name: Recipe ingredient and step lists
card.fires_on: Separators (space, comma, 'and') inside a recipe ingredient list or method, right before the next ingredient such as salt pork or beef. It also fires weakly on digits and punctuation inside numbers and scripture references.

modes.label: Recipe ingredient breaks
modes.description: The gap or comma between ingredients in a braised-beef recipe, just before the next item.

modes.description: A digit or colon inside a zip code, verse reference or statistic.
